description: Deals that started or stopped meeting a shopper's requirements since your last check. Returns change events for a category (v1: "tv"): price changed, back in stock, out of stock, deal expired (verified at the shop, each with source and checked_at), plus coupon changes marked "as_posted" (not verified; they never make a deal qualify). With filters, each item is newly_qualifies, stopped_qualifying or still_qualifies_changed; deals that failed before and after are left out. Pass next_cursor back as since_cursor next time with the same filters (a cursor reused with other filters is refused). Omit since_cursor for the last 24 hours. Screen size comes from the title (size_source "title"); an unknown size never passes a size filter. Store pickup is not covered. Read-only.
name: get_deal_changes
title: What changed? Verified deal changes
